name: BranchSel
stmt: def BranchSel (cond : ℝ) (then_ else_ : F) : F
proof:
if 0 < cond then then_ else else_

               
                            

omit [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] in

name: branch_then_when_positive
stmt:
theorem branch_then_when_positive (cond : ℝ) (t e : F) (h : 0 < cond) :
    BranchSel cond t e = t
proof:
by
  unfold BranchSel
  exact if_pos h

               
                       

omit [NormedAddCommGroup F] [NormedSpace ℝ F] in

name: branch_else_when_nonpos
stmt:
theorem branch_else_when_nonpos (cond : ℝ) (t e : F) (h : cond ≤ 0) :
    BranchSel cond t e = e
proof:
by
  unfold BranchSel
  exact if_neg (not_lt.mpr h)

name: branch_constraint_when_then
stmt:
theorem branch_constraint_when_then (cond : ℝ) (t e : F) (W : F →L[ℝ] ℝ) (b : ℝ)
    (hcond : 0 < cond) (ht : W t + b = 0) :
    W (BranchSel cond t e) + b = 0
proof:
by
                             
  rw [branch_then_when_positive cond t e hcond]
  exact ht

name: branch_condition_equals_relu_mask
stmt:
theorem branch_condition_equals_relu_mask (cond : ℝ) :
    (0 < cond ↔ reluSoftMask cond = 1) ∧ (cond ≤ 0 ↔ reluSoftMask cond = 0)
proof:
by
  constructor
  · constructor
    · intro h
      unfold reluSoftMask
      exact if_pos h
    · intro h
      unfold reluSoftMask at h
      by_cases hc : 0 < cond
      · exact hc
      · rw [if_neg hc] at h
        norm_num at h
  · constructor
    · intro h
      unfold reluSoftMask
      exact if_neg (not_lt.mpr h)
    · intro h
      unfold reluSoftMask at h
      by_cases hc : 0 < cond
      · rw [if_pos hc] at h
        norm_num at h
      · exact le_of_not_gt hc

                          
                                         

omit [NormedSpace ℝ F] in

name: branch_output_bound
stmt:
theorem branch_output_bound (cond : ℝ) (t e : F) (M : ℝ)
    (ht : ‖t‖ ≤ M) (he : ‖e‖ ≤ M) :
    ‖BranchSel cond t e‖ ≤ M
proof:
by
  unfold BranchSel
  by_cases h : 0 < cond
  · rw [if_pos h]
    exact ht
  · rw [if_neg h]
    exact he

end Lattice
